# CV-tuned long-horizon models: tuning and validation hold-out (generated by `scripts/run_long_cv_tuning.py`)

Git commit `2a88ce91e1`. Configuration chosen by expanding-window cross-validation inside the training period (three half-year folds of 2022-H2, 2023-H1, 2023-H2); the validation half-year (2024-H1) is NOT used for stopping or selection here. MAE in MW, mean prediction of 3 seeds.

## Horizon 72 h

CV choice: ridge ridge_full_rel alpha 100; XGBoost 144 trees (per fold [144, 41, 146], CV MAE 5,590); LSTM hidden 32, epochs 4 (per fold [2, 4, 4], CV MAE 5,874). Original (validation-tuned) choice: XGBoost trees [272, 419, 439], LSTM epochs [2, 1, 1].

| model | validation hold-out MAE (MW) |
|---|---:|
| ridge | 5,266 |
| XGBoost S4 | 5,359 |
| LSTM L4 | 5,822 |

## Horizon 168 h

CV choice: ridge ridge_g01_rel alpha 100; XGBoost 41 trees (per fold [41, 39, 305], CV MAE 7,125); LSTM hidden 16, epochs 1 (per fold [1, 2, 1], CV MAE 7,615). Original (validation-tuned) choice: XGBoost trees [2, 2, 2], LSTM epochs [1, 1, 1].

| model | validation hold-out MAE (MW) |
|---|---:|
| ridge | 6,062 |
| XGBoost S4 | 6,998 |
| LSTM L4 | 6,967 |
